name: Will
source:
The youngest of the Sherwood rebels, a self-styled gentleman rogue with several Sherwood-sized chips on his shoulder. Known as the Scarlet Blade, he's a master swordsman and a skilled footpad to boot. He possesses a natural charm, but it's hidden under a sardonic, resentful front. It seems that he only comes alive when he's living on the edge, fighting for his life. What made him this way, and why does he seem to be hiding so many secrets?

Strengths: Extremely skilled, strong convictions, shows no fear
Flaws: Closed-off, resentful, impulsive risk-taker

Likes: Swordplay, woodworking, freedom
Dislikes: Elitism, being coddled, Layton Tuck

[From [url=https://velvet-cupcake-games.itch.io/made-marion]itch.io[/url]]
